title: The Price of Intelligence - AI Agent Pricing in 2025
talk_summary: The talk surveys AI-agent pricing models such as outcome-based pricing, credits, and hybrid tiers, arguing for simplicity, predictable spend, margin defense, and flexible pricing. It is mostly SaaS monetization advice, but two mechanisms transfer: multi-model routing to cut inference cost and explicit workload/cost guardrails.

takeaways.what_they_do: Jasper routes each job across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Cohere models to pick the right one, reducing costs enough to offer unlimited credits on some tiers.
They advise mapping cost axes and identifying degenerate use cases, then defending margin with limits or pricing rather than assuming every workload is healthy.
takeaways.evidence_quote: think about what are the degenerate cases how are you going to defend against those

takeaways.what_they_do: For outcome-based pricing they expect clearer definitions of success and SLAs, not vague guarantees.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we'll need to get real about what exactly are the guarantees and the slas
